mainEntity.name: Can Zen Tiny Homes integrate off-grid capabilities into a custom tiny home design?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, Zen Tiny Homes can integrate various off-grid solutions into your custom tiny home. Options include solar panel systems for electricity, rainwater harvesting systems for water supply, composting toilets, and propane or wood-burning heating solutions. We discuss your specific off-grid goals during the design phase to incorporate the most suitable and efficient systems, allowing your tiny home to operate independently of traditional utility connections where desired.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, we can integrate off-grid capabilities like solar power, rainwater harvesting, and composting toilets. We discuss your needs to design the most efficient systems for your tiny home.
